description: Image generation via the LLM Gateway (POST /v1/images/generations) with automatic variant rendering into MCP storage. Generates text-to-image and image-to-image (editing) results, renders a fixed set of webp sizes (full, 1920, 1280, 720, 180) plus the lossless PNG original (<base>_full.png — platforms like YouTube reject webp) and a JSON sidecar with prompt/metadata, and returns the file list along with a small inline thumbnail.

tools.name: image_generate
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt (or edit reference images when `references` is given) via the gateway's image models. The result is rendered into MCP storage under images/ as webp in five sizes — <base>_full.webp, <base>_1920.webp, <base>_1280.webp, <base>_720.webp, <base>_180.webp — plus the lossless PNG original <base>_full.png (for platforms that reject webp, e.g. YouTube uploads) and <base>.json with the full prompt, model, usage/cost, and lineage. Vector models (OmniSVG, StarVector) instead return <base>.svg written verbatim plus _preview.webp and _thumb.webp rasters — no size set, no PNG, since vectors rescale losslessly. Base name: YYYYMMDD_HHMM_<slug>. Returns the storage paths of all files plus an inline preview (largest derived variant, 1280px). The caller copies out whichever sizes it needs (e.g. for documents, og:images, thumbnails). Downscales are shrink-only: sources smaller than a size yield that size identical to full. Optional `references` enables image-to-image editing on models with editing capability — pass storage paths (e.g. 'images/foo_720.webp') or http(s) URLs. Generation can take 1-2 minutes; the tool handles the long wait internally.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the desired image (required).

name.description: Optional slug for the file base name. Defaults to a slug derived from the first words of the prompt.

references.description: Optional image references for image-to-image editing: storage paths (relative to storage root) or http(s) URLs. Requires an editing-capable model.

model.description: Gateway image model ID (e.g. 'krea-2-image', 'qwen-image-3'). Omit to use the gateway's default imagegen task routing — recommended.

size.description: OpenAI-style 'WxH' (e.g. '3840x2160'). Forwarded upstream as exact pixel dimensions (width/height) — never snapped or discarded, so 4K requests arrive as 4K and custom ratios (e.g. 1920x960) keep their composition. Default when omitted (and no aspect_ratio): 1920x1440 (4:3 at 2K).

aspect_ratio.description: Direct 'W:H' composition preset (e.g. '16:9'). Validated against the model's declared ratios. When given alongside size, the explicit resolution is still preserved and the ratio rides along as metadata.

seed.description: Seed passed through to the provider.

extra_body.description: Provider extras merged into the request (e.g. Krea: creativity, intensity, complexity, movement).

tools.name: image_ingest
tools.description: Return an existing image as an MCP image block so the calling model can look at it — the counterpart to image_generate. Resizing is not the point; it exists only to keep the block cheap. Accepts a storage path, an absolute path inside the allowed roots, or an http(s) URL. Supports a pixel crop (read one label band at a time) and an upscale for small type. Returns the image first and a metadata block second, ending with a line that tells the caller what it means if no image arrived: some hosts drop image blocks, and then the model must say so instead of guessing.

source.description: Storage path (images/foo.png), absolute path inside the allowed roots, or http(s) URL.

sources.description: Up to 4 sources in one call. Prefer one image and crop it — a tool that accepts twenty will quietly fill the context.

max_dimension.description: Longest edge after resizing. Default 1600. 0 = never resize (the source passes through untouched, and may then exceed the block ceiling).

format.description: Output format. Default png — measured: the VS Code MCP client rejects webp image blocks outright and accepts png. Use webp only for a host you know accepts it; it is several times smaller.

region.description: Crop in SOURCE pixels, applied before any resize. This is how charts get verified: read one label band at a time.

upscale.description: 1.0-3.0, default 1.0. Small type reads better enlarged; applies after crop, as the resize target.

label.description: One-line caption placed at the top of the metadata block (e.g. 'variant B: prose + inventory').
